finding: Stated in abstract; full methods paywalled, medium and top MIC concentration not retrievable

claim: SH3b loss costs potency rather than function
finding: 8.6x turbidity and 10x plate-lysis penalty for CBD loss in homolog PlyTW; Ca2+ activates 2.8-8.2x; EDTA and Zn2+ inhibit all constructs
context: Twort endolysin, S. aureus Newman, SLB buffer

claim: CHAP-only is intrinsically weak on live cells
finding: CHAP-only C165 3,690 U/mg vs LysK 621 U/mg on live MRSA in 50 mM sodium acetate pH 6.5
confidence: high; different buffer and tag status

claim: Growing cells in rich broth tolerate endolysins
finding: Lys11 at 25-50 nM caused no lysis of log-phase cells in TSB+0.5 mM Ca over 60 min; 100-500 nM gave 20-70% OD drop
context: S. aureus RN4220, TSB, log phase

claim: Wall teichoic acids limit endolysin access
finding: WTA are major determinants of endolysin tolerance, severely hindering CBD binding; PMF collapse raises binding and lysis
confidence: moderate; growth-phase WTA change not directly measured

claim: CHAP-only is less stable than the fusion
finding: LysK inactivates by aggregation; Ca2+ and polyols give >100x stabilisation; sharp loss at 40-42 C. No CHAP vs CHAP-SH3b comparison
context: Purified LysK, autoclaved S. aureus substrate
confidence: high for LysK, does not address the truncation

claim: Isolated CHAP is a stable autonomous fold
finding: CHAPk crystal structure at high resolution with structural Ca2+ (Asp45/Asp47/Tyr49/His51/Asp56) and loosely bound active-site Zn2+; Asp45/47/56 mutants abolish lysis
confidence: high for folding, silent on solution half-life

claim: SH3b raises activity of a natural CHAP-SH3b Kayvirus endolysin
finding: LysF1 CHAP-only variant had decreased lytic activity; SH3b binds several peptidoglycan types; NMR did not confirm pentaglycine binding

claim: Broth microdilution MIC is unreliable for staphylolytic enzymes
finding: Body text: the Jones et al. microdilution broth method 'failed to yield a clear MIC' for SA2-E-Lyso-SH3b and SA2-E-LysK-SH3b, so plate lysis was used instead
context: Donovan laboratory, same MIC protocol lineage
confidence: high; quote from article body, not abstract
